name: Voyagers in Darkness
legend: Some shield companies of the Adeptus Custodes set sail into the darkness between the stars, either guided by visions of the Emperor’s will or believing that they can do the most to defend Terra by seeking out and destroying distant threats.

rules.name: Overwhelming Magnificence
rules.legend: To confront the towering, auramite-clad warriors of the Adeptus Custodes across an open battlefield is terrifying enough. To meet them in the cramped confines of a voidship is so overwhelming as to render many foes witless.
rules.description_html: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.
rules.description_text: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: ARTIFICER ROUNDS
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These hand-crafted bolt shells are made to fragment with particular ferocity, making them ideal for boarding actions.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".

stratagems.name: AURIC STORM
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even the boldest foes falter before the sudden and unstoppable onslaught of the Allarus Terminators.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

stratagems.name: BREACHING BEHEMOTHS
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: When unleashed aboard an enemy voidship, Custodians simply smash a path through any who stand against them by their sheer armoured might.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE VENGEANCE
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The incredible sensory acuity of the Custodians' wargear coupled with their superhuman senses means no foe can hide from them.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.

enhancements.name: Voidstrider
enhancements.legend: At home in voidborne warfare, this superhuman warrior is able to move with marked purpose and speed.
enhancements.description_html: Add 2" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.
enhancements.description_text: Add 2" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.

enhancements.name: Mantle of the Emissary
enhancements.legend: This ancient cloak symbolises its wearer’s dedication to a vision-sent mission from the Emperor, and fills them with overwhelming purpose and determination.
enhancements.description_html: The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.
